Module com.example._0zo
Package com.example._0zo.model.game

Class GameState

java.lang.Object
com.example._0zo.model.game.GameState
public class GameState extends Object
Manages the state of the poker game during play. This class tracks active players, manages turn progression, counts rounds, and determines when the game is over. It maintains the player list and cycles through active players for turn management.

    • getActivePlayers

      public List<Player> getActivePlayers()
      Gets a list of all currently active players. Active players are those who have not been eliminated from the game.
      Returns:
      a list of active players

    • isGameOver

      public boolean isGameOver()
      Checks if the game is over. The game is over when only one or fewer players remain active.
      Returns:
      true if the game is over, false otherwise

    • getCurrentPlayer

      public Player getCurrentPlayer()
      Gets the current player whose turn it is. The current player is determined by cycling through active players. Returns null if there are no active players.
      Returns:
      the current player, or null if no active players

    • advanceTurn

      public void advanceTurn()
      Advances to the next player's turn and increments the round count. If there are no active players, does nothing.
